manifest.name: Sunrise
manifest.author: CardSpoke Community
manifest.description: A warm, energizing theme with golden yellows and coral oranges

css: :root { --bg-primary: #fff9f0; --bg-secondary: #fff3e0; --bg-card: #ffffff; --text-primary: #4a3728; --text-secondary: #7d6854; --accent: #ff8a50; --accent-hover: #ff6b2c; --border-color: #f4d9bc; --shadow-color: rgba(255,138,80,0.1); } body { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #fff9f0 0%, #ffe8cc 100%) !important; color: var(--text-primary) !important; } .card, .card-item { background-color: var(--bg-card) !important; border: 1px solid var(--border-color) !important; color: var(--text-primary) !important; box-shadow: 0 2px 12px var(--shadow-color) !important; border-radius: 12px !important; } .card-item:hover { border-color: var(--accent) !important; box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(255,138,80,0.2) !important; transform: translateY(-2px); transition: all 0.2s ease; } header, .header { background-color: var(--bg-secondary) !important; border-bottom: 2px solid var(--border-color) !important; color: var(--text-primary) !important; } button { background-color: var(--bg-card) !important; border: 1px solid var(--border-color) !important; color: var(--text-primary) !important; border-radius: 8px !important; } button:hover { background-color: var(--accent) !important; color: #fff !important; border-color: var(--accent) !important; } .modal-content, .menu-section { background-color: var(--bg-card) !important; border: 1px solid var(--border-color) !important; color: var(--text-primary) !important; border-radius: 16px !important; } input, textarea, select { background-color: var(--bg-card) !important; border: 1px solid var(--border-color) !important; color: var(--text-primary) !important; border-radius: 8px !important; } input:focus, textarea:focus { border-color: var(--accent) !important; outline: none !important; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(255,138,80,0.1) !important; } .tag { background-color: var(--accent) !important; color: #fff !important; border-radius: 16px !important; padding: 4px 12px !important; } .breadcrumb a, a { color: var(--accent) !important; } .toast { background-color: var(--bg-card) !important; color: var(--text-primary) !important; border-left: 4px solid var(--accent) !important; box-shadow: 0 4px 16px var(--shadow-color) !important; }
